# Syed Ali — Web Developer

## About
I am a web developer based in Quetta, Pakistan, and I work remotely across time zones. I build and fix websites with Next.js and TypeScript.

- Website build plus — $499 USD — a multi-page website built with Next.js and TypeScript; delivered in seven days.
